subject: Transition from retainer to usage billing — PO format & net-term phasing
messages:
From: Susan Wong <susan.wong@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO requirements for Q3 retainer + usage billing

Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Greenfield wants to lock the commercial mechanics before legal moves the contract forward. A few must-haves on our side before we can issue a PO: 

- We need either two separate POs (one for the $75k monthly retainer, one for variable usage) or a single blanket PO with clearly separated line items by SKU and an explicit PO identifier on each invoice.
- Net terms: standard is net60 for our finance team. If a shorter term is required, we need an internal escalation.
- Invoices must be issued monthly and include a usage CSV attachment (lines: timestamp, model, tokens, cost) for reconciliation with our internal chargeback system.
- Discount: we can commit to a 6-month Q3+Q4 retainer if Redwood can provide a 20% discount on the retainer line. Usage beyond committed tokens would be billed at list less 10%.
- We need a PO template that includes your tax ID and remit instructions — I attached our internal PO template for your billing team to confirm format.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate the split-PO/line-item requirement and net60? If net60 is a hard no, please advise the escalation path.

Susan
SUSAN WONG
Senior Procurement Manager, Greenfield Health
Procurement@greenfieldhealth.com

Attachment: GFH_PO_TEMPLATE_2026.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Wong <susan.wong@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-27T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements for Q3 retainer + usage billing

Hi Susan —

Really appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front: we can support line-item separation on a single blanket PO (preferred) and include a PO identifier on every invoice; we can attach the token-level CSV on monthly invoices.

On net60: that is outside our standard self-serve terms for new customers on hosted plans, but for committed retainer deals we typically do a finance review. Proposed compromise: Redwood can accept net45 for the first two invoices while we complete internal risk checks, then move to net30 effective after the initial quarter. I know you asked for net60 — I flagged it for leadership escalation in case your AP team deems net45 insufficient.

Regarding discounts: I attached our current pricing slab (Redwood_PRICING_SLABS_Q3_v2.pdf). The commercial team is willing to do a 18% retainer discount for a 6-month committed retainer or 15% if you prefer a 3-month commitment. Usage overage pricing can be set at list minus 10% as you proposed.

Next steps I suggest:
- I’ll share a redlined PO example back to you by EOD so your AP can confirm the fields;
- Finance (Vivek) and Legal (Vanessa) are looped for the net-term and tax ID details;
- If net60 is required, can you share the approval timeline so we can get a final answer from leadership?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps speed alignment.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood_PRICING_SLABS_Q3_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements for Q3 retainer + usage billing

Hannah —

Saw Susan's asks. A couple of internal constraints to flag before we commit externally: 

- A sustained 18% retainer discount is steeper than our typical threshold for mid-market deals; recommend we hold to 15% for 6 months or 18% for 3 months as you noted.
- Net60 is a material cash-flow concession. If we're being asked to accept net60, we should request a prepayment tranche equal to one month of retainer or an ARR-backed guarantee. That reduces exposure and is a reasonable compromise.
- If we accept single blanket PO with line-item separation, billing needs a standard field for the 'PO line id' so we can map invoices to the committed token slab in our billing system. Include that field in the example PO.

I'll approve net45 for the initial two invoices, but net60 would need explicit approval from finance leadership and a prepayment or preauthorized lockbox. If Susan can't move on net terms, let's surface to Sales Leadership.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Wong <susan.wong@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@greenfieldhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-29T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Final proposal: PO format, discount, and invoice cadence (DocuSign link)

Susan —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Below is Redwood's proposal to unblock PO issuance quickly while addressing finance/operational constraints. If this looks good we can send a DocuSign for signature today.

Proposal summary:
- PO: single blanket PO with two distinct line items: (1) Monthly retainer (committed slab) and (2) Variable usage. Each invoice will include the blanket PO number and a dedicated PO line id.
- Invoice cadence: monthly. Each invoice will include a usage CSV (timestamp, model, tokens, unit price, line total) as an attachment.
- Discounting: 15% discount on the retainer for a 6-month commitment (Aug–Jan). If Greenfield prefers an 18% discount, we can offer that for a 3-month trial period only.
- Net terms: net45 for the first two invoices while our risk checks complete, then net30 thereafter. If Greenfield requires net60, a prepayment equal to one retainer month is required or an AP-verified lockbox arrangement.
- Deliverables: I attached a redlined PO example (GFH_PO_TEMPLATE_2026.xlsx) formatted with the PO line id field for your AP team to validate.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/samples/redirect/abcd-efgh-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/GFH-2026-1739

Please confirm which discount cadence you prefer (15%/6mo or 18%/3mo) and whether net45 for the first two invoices is acceptable. If OK, we’ll send the DocuSign and a templated invoice stub to your AP today.

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
